name: Dave McCormick
summary: Record covers 10 of 10 issues, drawn from 10 archived campaign statements. States that veterans need access to quality health care, including mental health care. States support for a market-driven, all-of-the-above energy agenda including Pennsylvania natural gas, and for addressing climate change through adaptation rather than government spending. States support for a larger defense budget, a stronger defense industrial base and deterrence of adversaries.
asymmetry_note: Incumbents are judged on what they did (roll-call votes, sponsored bills). Challengers can only be judged on what they say (stated positions). These are not equivalent kinds of evidence; the record type is labeled on every item.

stances.position: States that veterans need access to quality health care, including mental health care.

evidence.title: Supporting Pennsylvania's Veterans
evidence.description: "Dave knows that we need to equip our veterans with not just quality health care, but mental health care."

stances.position: States support for a market-driven, all-of-the-above energy agenda including Pennsylvania natural gas, and for addressing climate change through adaptation rather than government spending.

evidence.title: Growing Pennsylvania's Energy Sector
evidence.description: "We need market-driven solutions and an "all of the above" energy agenda, not government spending that drives inflation."

stances.position: States support for a larger defense budget, a stronger defense industrial base and deterrence of adversaries.

evidence.title: America on the World Stage
evidence.description: "As Senator, he'll work to restore America's military might, strengthen our defense industrial base, reestablish deterrence of our adversaries, and make sure the world knows we're not planning to relinquish our superpower status anytime soon."

stances.position: States that U.S. leadership in blockchain and crypto is an economic and national security priority that policymakers should support.

evidence.title: Crypto
evidence.description: "American leadership on blockchain and crypto is critical to our economic and national security. They offer America the chance to lead another generation of innovation, but policymakers must do their part, or this opportunity will slip away."

stances.position: States he would work to secure the southern border, end drug and human trafficking and increase resources for Border Patrol agents.

evidence.title: Securing Our Border
evidence.description: "As Senator, Dave will fight to secure the border, put an end to drug and human trafficking, and support our border patrol agents with the resources they need to do their jobs."

stances.position: States he is pro-life, opposes a national abortion ban and supports exceptions for rape, incest and the life of the mother.

evidence.title: Abortion
evidence.description: "Dave is pro-life, is opposed to a national abortion ban, and supports exceptions in the cases of rape, incest, and saving the life of the mother."

stances.position: States support for an individual right to own firearms, alongside school security funding, mental health programs, enforcement of existing gun laws and background check systems.

evidence.title: Second Amendment
evidence.description: "Dave is a strong supporter of the Second Amendment and believes law-abiding citizens have an individual right to own firearms for self-defense, hunting, collecting, and sport-shooting, for any lawful reason"

stances.position: States he would work to reduce government spending, oppose tax increases and exercise fiscal responsibility.

evidence.title: Inflation & the Economy
evidence.description: "in the Senate he'll work to rein in government spending, oppose tax increases, and exercise fiscal responsibility to lessen the burden on the people of the commonwealth."

stances.position: States support for re-energizing innovation through STEM education, technical skills training and technological and data leadership.

evidence.title: Harnessing American Innovation
evidence.description: "Today, we need to re-energize innovation, including through improving education in math, science, and engineering as well as technical skills training, and driving technological and data leadership"

stances.position: States support for a plan of six bans aimed at reducing U.S. economic dependence on China, including for lithium batteries and solar panels.

evidence.title: Ending China's Free Rein
evidence.description: "Dave introduced a plan to fortify American military and economic strength, thwart China's aggressive ambitions and protect the homeland through six bans to end China's free ride."
